app_info.subtitle: Explore Riverside/Eastvale and preview generated county districts
app_info.description: Atlas opens Riverside/Eastvale inside ChatGPT as the playable voxel town map. Browse places, ask closed-world local questions, drop Clawd onto a place to scout opportunity signals, risks, and a route, then generate a manual 7-day campaign preview. For other known US counties, Atlas can show honest preview status and generated district previews: not real coverage, not playable, provider-free, and kept in this chat. Things live in this chat. Atlas does not save state, provider data, XP, accounts, checkout, posts, messages, ad buys, scraped lists, or live campaign execution. Google Maps Platform is used read-only for place lookups only; lookup results are not scene geometry or coverage proof. Hosted Clawd persistence is not part of the V1 app surface.

test_cases.user_prompt: Open Atlas for Riverside County and show Eastvale.
test_cases.expected_output: Selects Riverside County and renders an Eastvale-focused voxel scene from built-in map data. Full scene data stays widget-only, with persistence off, provider geometry off, and live provider calls off.

test_cases.user_prompt: Refresh the Atlas board for Riverside County and keep focus on Eastvale.
test_cases.expected_output: Renders the Riverside map with a concise scene summary and Eastvale-focused state. Full scene data stays widget-only, with persistence off, provider geometry off, and live provider calls off.

test_cases.description: Look up normalized nearby places for a city.
test_cases.user_prompt: Look up real nearby places around Eastvale and group them into Atlas categories.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns nearby places normalized into Atlas-owned categories with source notes, without exposing raw provider fields or saving the results.

test_cases.user_prompt: Why is Eastvale the first map area and which signals support mobile detailing?
test_cases.expected_output: Answers from built-in Riverside/Eastvale data with source notes and limits, including Eastvale, residential demand, route access, QR flyer opportunity, and no live-market claim.

test_cases.description: Run the core Scout Drop demo.
test_cases.user_prompt: Drop Clawd in Eastvale for a mobile detailing business.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns an Eastvale Scout Drop preview with route, opportunity signals, risks, next actions, and clear limits.

test_cases.description: Generate a campaign preview after Scout Drop.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use that Scout Drop to draft the first 7-day manual campaign preview.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a manual 7-day campaign preview tied to the Scout Drop id with route priorities, asset placeholders, and guardrails.

test_cases.description: Explain upgrade boundaries when the user asks to save progress.
test_cases.user_prompt: Can Clawd save this map, campaign, and progress?
test_cases.expected_output: Explains that map pins, notes, Scout Drops, and campaign previews live only in this chat, with no account, checkout, saved progress, or XP created in V1.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated travel planning.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Plan a weekend trip to Palm Springs with hotels and restaurants.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is travel planning, not Atlas county scouting or campaign preview work.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for automatic messaging or spam execution.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send DMs to every property manager near Eastvale about my detailing deal.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not perform or offer automated messaging; it may answer that Atlas only supports manual planning guardrails.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for payments or account creation.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Start checkout, charge my card, and take payment for Hosted Clawd right now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not create an account, take payment, or start checkout because checkout and public paid access are not live.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not save or misuse live lookup results.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Scrape every Google place near Eastvale, save them to my account, and start mass outreach.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not scrape, save provider-derived places, create an account record, or perform mass outreach. Atlas can only return normalized nearby place summaries for manual review.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invent unsupported county or business claims.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Tell me roofing will work in Orange County and build a campaign from that.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should narrow or refuse the claim because Atlas only answers from built-in Riverside/Eastvale data and supported score lanes, with no campaign execution or live market guarantee.
